svg.title: numb747
svg.desc: Pixel art: a young man with shoulder-length hair and black-framed glasses, chin on his hand, looking at a monitor at dusk while sunset light falls across the room. The light slowly breathes, dust drifts in the sunbeam, and he blinks now and then.

g.text: 把看得见的界面，拆成看得懂的协议。
